Game Overview

At its heart, Pixel Assembly is a pixel game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Pixel Assembly doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Pixel Assembly?

Pixel Assembly is a free pixel game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Pixel Assembly free to play?

Yes, Pixel Assembly is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
